verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships as a dependency-free C/C++ binary with pre-built releases (no Python stack to load), and users report it 'started off as CPU-only' and 'totally detached from Python ML ecosystem,' with trivially easy setup on M1 and fast token generation once running. However, no evidence directly measures or claims fast cold-start/time-to-first-token versus heavier runtimes. Missing for 10: explicit cold-start latency benchmarks, first-party claims about startup time specifically.
